findings-analysis.description: Abstract vocabulary — "palpable silence" uses an abstract psychological adjective that violates the narrator's documented avoidance of such descriptors. The fingerprint signature is concrete, tactile, procedural language.

findings-analysis.originalText: There was a palpable silence on the shingle while I stood with my hand on her gunwale and worked out which of those facts I would mention to him first. Behind the island the sunset bled crimson and gold across the heavens. What held me was the smaller arithmetic: the rope and the ring and the salt that held them together, and the tin I found wedged under the stone I had found the first letter under, weeks ago, when this was still a story about grief.

findings-analysis.originalText: Walking back up the steps, the lamp seemed dimmer than it should, though the wick was right and the glass was clean.
